remarks: Welcome home to a quintessential Greenwich estate with incredible views, privacy, and all the bells and whistles one could want. Spend the summer lounging by the pool and dining on the expansive terrace, watching the sunsets. The five-bedroom main house is professionally decorated, combining modern elegance with antique chic. It includes a fabulous sunroom overlooking the property, a chef's kitchen, and many social spaces, including a billiards room, private offices, and a gym with a steam room. Overflow guests will be ecstatic to enjoy the two-bedroom guest cottage on the property. Close to both downtown Greenwich and Bedford, this property is surrounded by horse farms and is in an excellent estate location with easy access to NYC. Note the property address is Greenwich, however the property falls within Stamford Public School district. Property available for month of June and July 20 -Aug 31.
